about: Files that hold a security property on their own. A push changing one needs a commit in it with a 'Security review:' line (the pre-push hook checks); MAGI DEV re-reviews each on every change (review-pipeline, boundary risk class). Add a guard by adding an entry; each names the tests that attack it.

guards.why: BrowseWeb's only way out: every request vetted and connected to the vetted address (F-002, F-043). CodeQL's SSRF alert #2 on it was dismissed as a false positive on 2026-11-25.
Decides what is private: every resolved address and IP literal, in every encoding; fails closed on a lookup error.
FetchUrl's client: vets and pins every redirect hop, caps size and time.
